title: Inside the Royal Portuguese Reading Room in Rio de Janeiro
description: Three stories of floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, carved dark wood balconies, gilded Gothic details and a glowing chandelier fill the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura. This breathtaking library in #RioDeJaneiro holds over 350,000 volumes and feels straight out of a fairytale. A dream stop for book lovers visiting #Rio and #Brazil.

title: Carved Stone Doorway into the Real Gabinete Library, Rio
description: A carved limestone archway with gilded flowers and a golden monogram frames the entrance to the Royal Portuguese Reading Room, where visitors gaze up at towering bookshelves. Remember to keep quiet inside this historic #RioDeJaneiro library. One of the most beautiful libraries in the world, right in downtown #Rio, #Brazil.
alt_text: Ornate carved stone doorway with gilded floral trim and a gold monogram opening into the bookshelf-lined reading room of the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura in Rio de Janeiro, with visitors inside

title: Gothic Stained Glass Door at the Real Gabinete, Rio de Janeiro
description: Soft light glows through red, blue and amber stained glass in a Gothic stone doorway at the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura. Moody hallways, carved arches and bronze plaques make this historic #RioDeJaneiro library a dream for architecture photography. A hidden gem in downtown #Rio worth adding to your #Brazil itinerary.
alt_text: Gothic carved stone archway framing a glass door with red, blue and amber stained glass panels in a dim warm hallway of the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura in Rio de Janeiro

title: Gilded Ceiling and Lantern at the Real Gabinete, Rio de Janeiro
description: Gold leaf quatrefoil panels, carved rosettes and an iron lantern decorate the ceiling of the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura in downtown #RioDeJaneiro. Every corner of this Neo-Manueline library is a work of art, so remember to look up. Architecture and design lovers, save this #Rio gem for your #Brazil trip.
alt_text: Looking straight up at a gilded coffered ceiling with quatrefoil panels, gold rosettes and a hanging iron lantern inside the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura in Rio de Janeiro

title: Confeitaria Colombo: Rio de Janeiro's Historic Belle Époque Café
description: Founded in 1894, Confeitaria Colombo is the most famous café in #RioDeJaneiro, with giant Belgian mirrors, a sweeping wrought iron mezzanine, marble tables and cane chairs. Stop in for coffee and pastries in Centro and step back into Belle Époque #Rio. A must-visit for foodies and history lovers in #Brazil.
alt_text: Grand interior of Confeitaria Colombo in Rio de Janeiro with a curved wrought iron mezzanine, glowing ceiling lights, large mirrors, marble tables and cane-back chairs filled with diners

title: Coffee at Confeitaria Colombo: Mirrors, Marble and Cane Chairs
description: Huge jacaranda-framed mirrors, glowing brass lights and rows of marble tables make Confeitaria Colombo feel like a step back in time. This historic café in downtown #RioDeJaneiro has served coffee, pastéis de nata and Brazilian sweets for over a century. Add this classic #Rio café to your #Brazil food bucket list.

title: The Grand Interior of Confeitaria Colombo, Rio de Janeiro
description: Golden light, a stained glass skylight, ornate mirrors and a curving balcony make Confeitaria Colombo one of the most beautiful cafés in the world. This Belle Époque landmark in Centro is a must for coffee and pastries in #RioDeJaneiro. Save this for your #Rio café guide and #Brazil travel itinerary.

title: Brazil Flag Bikinis and Beach Towels for Sale in Rio de Janeiro
description: A blue beach umbrella hung with green and yellow Brazil flag bikinis, leopard print swimsuits and colorful cangas is a classic sight near Arpoador and #Ipanema. Beach vendors sell sarongs, Rio de Janeiro towels and swimwear right on the sand. The perfect souvenir from #RioDeJaneiro and a fun #Rio and #Brazil beach culture pin.

title: Crowds on Arpoador Rock at Golden Hour, Rio de Janeiro
description: As sunset approaches, crowds climb the famous Pedra do Arpoador while beachgoers relax under red and green umbrellas on the sand below. Watching the sun go down from Arpoador is a beloved ritual in #RioDeJaneiro, between #Ipanema and Copacabana. Don't miss this #Rio golden hour tradition on your trip to #Brazil.

title: Sunset Over Ipanema and Dois Irmãos from Arpoador, Rio
description: The sun sinks toward the twin peaks of Morro Dois Irmãos and Pedra da Gávea as swimmers float in the glittering waves of #Ipanema. Watching sunset from Arpoador is the most iconic evening in #RioDeJaneiro, often ending in applause. Add this unforgettable #Rio moment to your #Brazil bucket list.
